channel.title: The Morning Brief
channel.description: A private daily market brief: what moved overnight, why, and what to watch.
channel.itunes:author: Samuel Gibby
channel.itunes:summary: A private daily market brief: what moved overnight, why, and what to watch.

item.title: Fed Rate Hike Odds Spike, Stocks Slide
item.description: Yields hit levels not seen since 2007 as markets brace for a Fed hike this week, and oil climbs on a widening Middle East conflict.

item.title: Ten-Year Yield Hits Five Percent, AI Wobbles
item.description: Bond yields spiked to a 2007 high, oil is climbing, and AI's own leaders are calling for a slowdown right before Anthropic's IPO.

item.title: Hot CPI Sets Up a Fed Rate Hike
item.description: August inflation came in sticky, diesel topped six dollars, and traders are now betting the Fed hikes next week instead of cutting.

item.title: Oil Tops $100, Yields Surge, Fed Hike Odds Jump
item.description: Crude above $100, wholesale inflation hot, and traders now see a rate hike next week as more likely than not.

item.title: Oil Above $100 as US-Iran Conflict Escalates
item.description: Brent tops $101 on Gulf fighting, Treasury triples bond buybacks, and inflation reports loom over next week's Fed decision.

item.title: Oil Spikes, Trade War Deepens, Stocks Slide
item.description: Middle East escalation and a U.S.-Canada trade war send stocks lower and crude toward a hundred dollars.

item.title: Oil Spikes on Iran Strikes, Germany Rattled
item.description: Crude jumps to six-week highs as Iran and the US trade blows, while a far-right landslide in Germany shakes European politics.

item.title: Jobs Blow Past Expectations, Rate Cut Bets Shrink
item.description: A surprisingly strong jobs report scrambles rate cut timing, Trump threatens trade over Fed policy, and Tesla and Lululemon have rough days.

item.title: Rate-Hike Fears Fade, Broadcom and Snowflake Diverge
item.description: Waller talks down rate-hike bets, stocks surge, and Broadcom's AI forecast splits Wall Street from Snowflake's rally.

item.title: Yields Surge, Fed Hike Talk, Venezuela Oil Rush
item.description: Williams opens the door to a hike, Chevron and GE Vernova chase Venezuela, and Dell blows past every estimate.

item.title: Oil Spikes, Yields Jump, Stocks Slide
item.description: Strikes near the Strait of Hormuz send oil and bond yields higher together, and equities don't like either move.

item.title: Oil, Rates, and Iran Strikes Rattle Markets
item.description: US strikes on Iran push oil and mortgage rates higher, gold and crypto slide, and the ten-year flirts with a breakout toward five percent.

item.title: Warsh Talks Inflation, Markets Barely Blink
item.description: A hawkish Jackson Hole speech rattled gold and rates but left stocks basically flat on the week's last day.

item.title: Nvidia and Salesforce Power a Software-Chip Rally
item.description: Nvidia's blockbuster quarter and Salesforce's biggest day in years overshadow a hawkish Fed voice ahead of tomorrow's Jackson Hole speech.

item.title: Sticky Inflation, Nervous Markets, Nvidia Looms
item.description: Core PCE runs hot into Jackson Hole, futures dip, and Nvidia earnings land after the bell.

item.title: Canada Trade Talks Collapse, Nvidia Looms Large
item.description: Trade talks with Canada broke down, oil keeps sliding, and Wall Street holds its breath for Nvidia earnings.

item.title: Canada Trade War Escalates, Nvidia Looms
item.description: Tariffs on Canada collapse, Iran sanctions ramp up, and Wall Street braces for Nvidia earnings and Jackson Hole.

item.title: Bond Market Jitters Overshadow Nvidia Anticipation
item.description: Treasury's buyback push, a weak jobs report, and Nvidia earnings on deck — the debt story is running the show.

item.title: Iran Pressure, Walmart Slips, Yields Rebound
item.description: Trump escalates on Iran and sends oil higher, Walmart's beat comes with a soft US sales number, and yields erase Bessent's bounce.

item.title: Yields Ease, Moderna Soars, Fed Minutes Loom
item.description: Treasury buybacks calm the bond market while a Moderna-Merck cancer vaccine and Marvell's Google deal light up equities.

item.title: Long Bond Yields Hit Multi-Decade Highs
item.description: The thirty-year Treasury is at levels not seen since 2007, and stocks still haven't blinked.

item.title: Ceasefire Deadline Looms, Memory Chips Keep Ripping
item.description: Trump threatens Oman as the Iran ceasefire lapses, Micron crosses a thousand bucks, and the VIX hits a low nobody trusts.

item.title: Retail Sales Slump, Yet Records Keep Falling
item.description: Soft retail sales and flat wholesale prices meet Baltic drone tensions, as gold, silver, and stocks all sit near highs at once.

item.title: Soft Inflation Data, Loud AI Concentration Worries
item.description: Wholesale prices came in flat, rate-hike odds faded, and Steve Eisman flagged just how much of the AI trade rides on two companies.

item.title: Cool CPI, Hot Neoclouds, Grim Red Sea News
item.description: July inflation came in exactly as expected, CoreWeave and Nebius ripped on AI demand, and the Red Sea turned deadly again.

item.title: CoreWeave and Super Micro Lift AI Trade Again
item.description: Blowout AI earnings from CoreWeave and Super Micro headline a night dominated by oil, Iran, and tomorrow's inflation print.
